detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Bacteriostatic Water

Chemical Information:

Composition:

  • Primary Component: Water (H₂O)
  • Additive: Benzyl Alcohol (C₇H₈O), typically 9 mg/mL

Appearance: Clear, colorless solution
Solubility: Miscible with water

Product Description:

Bacteriostatic Water is a research-grade aqueous laboratory solution containing benzyl alcohol as an antimicrobial agent. It is supplied for use in controlled laboratory environments to support the preparation, dilution, and handling of research compounds under aseptic conditions. The inclusion of benzyl alcohol serves to inhibit microbial growth in multi-use research settings, supporting solution stability during repeated access within a defined research workflow. This material is provided in a sealed container to maintain integrity and consistency and is intended exclusively for in vitro and analytical laboratory applications conducted by qualified professionals. This product is not formulated for clinical, therapeutic, injectable, or any human or veterinary use.

Research Applications:

In controlled laboratory research settings, bacteriostatic water is utilized to support:

  • Preparation of aqueous solutions for research compounds
  • Controlled dilution and reconstitution processes in laboratory environments
  • Evaluation of compound solubility and compatibility in solution systems
  • Stability assessment of prepared research materials under defined conditions

All applications are conducted strictly within non-human, non-clinical research models.

Product Specifications:
  • Volume: 10mL
  • Composition: Sterile water with 0.9% benzyl alcohol
  • Purpose: Solvent/diluent for laboratory research applications
  • Vial Format: Intended for use in laboratory settings where multiple withdrawals may be performed under controlled handling procedures

Storage and Handling:

  • Store unopened vials at controlled room temperature: 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F)
  • After initial access, store under refrigeration: 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F)
  • Do not freeze
  • Discard remaining contents within 28 days of initial access according to proper laboratory handling protocols
Compliance Notice:

Bacteriostatic Water is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
